event_name: Date 18 June 2022 Time 20:23 2022 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 June 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 46) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter, and determine
fact: Failure to follow item 14 of the Race Director's Event Notes.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 2nd Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly) and team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 10 left the track at turn 9 and failed to keep completely to the left of the orange bollard before re-joining the track. The driver explained that he had issues with his brakes but accepts that he did not comply with the Race Director's instructions in this instance. The Stewards therefore determine that this is a breach of the above regulation by car 10.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Failure To Follow Rd Event Notes
